ev.q: made it burn far more brightly and almost without smoke

1.why: A段只说 Argand 灯更亮、几乎无烟，并取代了明火，完全没有比较运行成本。B段提到灯油 expensive，但那是说反射镜系统耗油多，并未与明火比较，所以是 NOT GIVEN 而不是 TRUE/FALSE。

ev.q: Even when freshly polished, a reflector absorbed around half of the light that fell on it

2.why: B段。However well it had been cleaned ↔ Even when freshly polished；failed to send out roughly half ↔ absorbed around half of the light（被吸收就是没有反射出去）。题干与原文意思一致。

ev.q: a great deal of light would be lost inside the glass itself

3.why: C段。an ordinary lens of sufficient size ↔ a conventional lens large enough；waste much of the light passing through it ↔ a great deal of light would be lost inside the glass itself。注意同句还说这种透镜会太厚太重，但题干只考光损失这一点。

ev.q: Fresnel presented his design in 1822, and the following year the first lens of this kind was installed

4.why: D段。made his design public ↔ presented his design（1822）；put into service ↔ installed，是 the following year（1823），并非同一年，与原文矛盾，故 FALSE。本题容易被当作“没提到”而误选 NOT GIVEN，其实 the following year 已给出时间关系。

ev.q: who was reluctant to spend money on lenses that had to be imported from France at considerable cost

5.why: E段只给出 Pleasonton 不愿买透镜的原因是进口费用高（at considerable cost），没有说他是否怀疑透镜效果更好。看起来像 FALSE，但原文对他是否相信透镜性能没有任何信息，所以是 NOT GIVEN。

ev.q: it is now found in car headlamps, traffic signals, overhead projectors and the flat plastic magnifiers

6.why: F段。原文说菲涅尔透镜原理如今用于车灯、交通信号灯、投影仪、放大镜和太阳能电站，说明仍在制造使用，与 no longer manufactured 矛盾。被灯塔自动化淘汰、送进博物馆的只是原来的玻璃透镜（the original glass lenses），这是本题陷阱。

ev.q: usually made of copper coated with silver and shaped as a parabola

7.why: B段。silver-plated ↔ coated with silver；parabolic dish ↔ curved metal reflector … shaped as a parabola。被镀银的金属是 copper；不要填 silver，题干已用 silver-plated 表示镀层。

ev.q: the silver surface was gradually worn away by the cleaning needed to remove soot

8.why: B段。surface slowly damaged ↔ gradually worn away；polishing to clear away ↔ cleaning needed to remove。同段的 oil 是燃料，不是被清理的东西。

ev.q: At the centre was a small, relatively thin lens known as the bull's-eye

9.why: C段。in the middle ↔ At the centre；thin central element called ↔ relatively thin lens known as。不要填 lens（太泛），也不要填 prisms（那是周围的环）。

ev.q: around it were rings of glass prisms, each one shaped so that it bent the light at exactly the angle needed to join the main beam

10.why: C段。surrounded by circles of ↔ around it were rings of；angled to bend light into the beam ↔ bent the light at exactly the angle needed to join the main beam。rings 已在题干中被改写为 circles，所以答案是 prisms（glass prisms 也可）。

ev.q: he died of tuberculosis in 1827, at the age of 39

11.why: D段末句：Fresnel 于 1827 年去世，享年 39 岁。age of an inventor at the time of his death ↔ died … at the age of 39。A段也提到发明者 Argand 和年代（1780s），但没有提他的年龄或去世。

ev.q: who was reluctant to spend money on lenses that had to be imported from France at considerable cost

12.why: E段。one nation was slow ↔ the United States was much slower；explanation ↔ Pleasonton 不愿花钱进口透镜。同段的 Britain 只说 1830s 开始安装，没有解释原因。

ev.q: it is now found in car headlamps, traffic signals, overhead projectors and the flat plastic magnifiers sold for reading small print

13.why: F段。present-day objects ↔ now found in car headlamps, traffic signals…；old optical principle ↔ The principle has outlived the lighthouses。D段虽然列出了不同 orders 的透镜用途（海岸灯、港口），但那是19世纪的灯塔，不是现代物品。
